verdict.rationale: The pack documents no data-export or account-portability capability, so nothing shows a user can export all their cubic data in open formats and leave. The Analytics API (PR-level metrics) and repo-stored cubic.yaml config are adjacent features: they cover only slices of the data and are not a documented full export. Missing for 10: any documented bulk export of reviews, learned memory, wiki and analytics in open formats, plus documented account exit or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
